chapter: Chicago, Lee Collins and the road
title: The Monogram theatre and Jack Johnson's Stutz
summary: Milt recalls the Monogram vaudeville house and staring at Jack Johnson's open Stutz car.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Well, from 31st Street, where the Vendome was, you'd come down State Street to 35th Street, and that's where the vaudeville house was. It was called the Monogram. Do you remember that?
There was another one. A little smaller theatre.

Across the street was where they had the movies, and at 35th and Wabash was where Jack Johnson lived, in that apartment building. He used to have that big old Stutz car sitting out in front. We used to come around and stare at it and look at it until he would come out and get in it. An open car.
Yeah, he was a giant. He was something.
Yeah, yeah, he was something. Yeah, that Chicago was something.
